title: tacrolimus-pgx-meta-analysis: R analysis pipeline for a systematic review and meta-analysis of CYP3A4, CYP3A5 and ABCB1 variants and tacrolimus pharmacokinetics
description:
R pipeline reproducing the random-effects meta-analysis of six pharmacogenetic variants — CYP3A4 rs2242480 (*1G) and rs35599367 (*22), CYP3A5 rs776746 (*3), and ABCB1 rs1045642, rs2032582 and rs1128503 — against dose-adjusted tacrolimus trough concentration (C0/D) in solid organ transplant recipients.

The pipeline fits multilevel random-effects models (metafor::rma.mv) with cluster-robust confidence intervals, runs the subgroup (organ, age group, time window and ancestry) and leave-one-out analyses, performs the overlap-risk sensitivity run, and generates all forest and funnel figures and summary tables in a single entry script. A synthetic example dataset is included so the pipeline runs end to end without the full extraction dataset.

The retrospective protocol for the review is registered on OSF (DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/XAPBR); deviations from the protocol are documented in docs/deviations.md.
